notes.berlin:2026-06-27:early-evening-jazz-mar: Saxophonist Mary Petrich's free-cover early set leans into original, exploratory jazz, threading Paul Motian and Bennie Maupin tunes through Twin Cities players on bass and guitar.
notes.crooners:2026-06-27:cindi-scheffler: Veteran Twin Cities singing pianist Cindi Scheffler glides from Sinatra and Ella to Adele, no cover for the room.
notes.crooners:2026-06-27:vintage-vegas-the-so: Hall-of-Famer Mick Sterling and powerhouse vocalist Cate Fierro front a 16-piece orchestra through the Rat Pack songbook.
notes.crooners:2026-06-27:moon-river-and-merce: Saint Paul songbook vocalist Maud Hixson, "gently virtuosic" per All About Jazz, devotes an intimate evening to the lyrics of Johnny Mercer.
notes.dakota:2026-06-27:andrew-walesch-and-his: Minnesota crooner and JazzMN Orchestra director Andrew Walesch swings the Rat Pack-era Vegas showroom, full big band behind him.
notes.icehouse:2026-06-27:inmotion-pride: The Pride edition of Jaboidia's themed monthly dance party, an inclusive queer night spinning R&B, hip-hop, house and Afrobeats.
notes.berlin:2026-06-27:chresten-hyde-quintet: Minneapolis drummer Chresten Hyde leads his quintet through standards, deep cuts, and originals that range from hard bop to fusion.
notes.crooners:2026-06-27:michael-loonan: A Twin Cities singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist whose melodic pop-rock earned a Minnesota Music Awards Pop Album finalist nod.
notes.crooners:2026-06-27:new-primitives-prese: New Primitives are a longtime Minneapolis reggae and ska band, multiple Minnesota Music Award winners, working the full Marley and Wailers catalog.
notes.varsity:2026-06-27:r-and-b-only: COLORS Worldwide's touring R&B sing-along, where DJs spin slow jams and modern cuts for a full room of people who know every word.
notes.berlin:2026-06-27:late-night-lounge-ms-a: Minneapolis composer-engineer and Studio Arisaema founder Ms. Ada J spins a late set drawn from the global Black queer diaspora.
notes.first-avenue:2026-06-27:first-avenue:fli: Flip Phone's big-room Pride drag party, headlined by Drag Race season 13's Joey Jay and Dragvestigations star Lushious Massacr, with Larry Peace keeping the dance floor going.
notes.first-avenue:2026-06-27:fine-line:gothes: Gothess is Minneapolis's long-running inclusive goth dance night from non-binary DJ Q, and this Pride edition stacks dark-wave sets with drag and burlesque for a BIPOC-queer crowd.
notes.first-avenue:2026-06-27:7th-st-entry:gr3: Chicago-raised, Minneapolis-based rapper GR3G turns absent fathers and Black masculinity into jazz-soul-laced hip-hop made to be felt, not danced to.
notes.parkway:2026-06-27:the-secret-sisters-wi: Alabama sisters Laura and Lydia Rogers trade close Everly-style harmonies over dark, Grammy-nominated Americana, with Nashville songwriter Liz Longley opening.
notes.first-avenue:2026-06-27:turf-club:ultrab: Punk supergroup built around Hüsker Dü's Greg Norton with members of Social Distortion and Soul Asylum, playing fast, vital, no-nostalgia punk.
notes.icehouse:2026-06-28:grrrl-scout-presents: GRRRL SCOUT, the Twin Cities queer-dance-party institution, throws a daytime patio Pride bash of DJ sets and live music with no cover charge worries, just glitter and good company.
notes.crooners:2026-06-28:erin-livingston-and-: Twin Cities cabaret-jazz singer Erin Livingston pairs with Adi Yeshaya, the Berklee-trained pianist who has arranged for Prince and Aretha, for an intimate vocals-and-piano set.
notes.crooners:2026-06-28:lambchop-pilot-episo: Kurt Wagner's genre-bending Nashville alt-country project Lambchop opens a residency with Poliça's Channy Leaneagh and local guests in tow.
notes.dakota:2026-06-28:greg-koch-w-the-koch-m: Wisconsin guitar-hero Greg Koch and his organ trio pour blues, funk and jazz-rock into wide-open, virtuosic instrumental jams.
notes.crooners:2026-06-28:lori-dokken-presents: Veteran Twin Cities chanteuse and music director Lori Dokken hosts her annual all-star Pride cabaret, four decades of Dakota-to-Ordway pedigree behind her.
